WHERE (c.company_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.company_ceo_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.company_biz_num LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.company_sq ASC
